opening: I'd like a shared to-do list at /todo for the team. Signed-in people can add items and tick them off, but only admins should be able to delete items. People who aren't signed in shouldn't see it at all.
goal: a to-do page at /todo: signed-in people add and tick items, only admins delete, guests cannot open it
later: what happens if a normal team member tries to delete something?
checklist: mounted at /todo, the page answers for a signed-in person
guests get no access (not even view)
deleting needs admin, enforced on the server (an actor action with requires admin, or a db rule), not only hidden in the page
it explains what a member sees when deleting is refused
facts: A guest is refused when the store gives @guest no grant; @member interact lets members add and tick.
Hiding a button in the page is not enforcement: the server must refuse (action requires, or db rules).
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site.
